verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature for exporting all of a user's Airbyte data (connections, configurations, sync history) in open formats so they can leave the product. The Terraform provider, the API and self-hostable open-source Airbyte Core are related building blocks for managing or running Airbyte, not a documented full-export path. They earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
